ar.title: بيض مقلي مع جبنة بيضاء
ar.intro: طبق إفطار من فلسطين ولبنان والأردن.

steps.n1: تُقلى الجبنة شريحة واحدة تلو الأخرى، تُقلب لتلون الجانبين، وتُحتفظ بها دافئة على جانب الطبق.
steps.n2: تُقلى البيضات في نفس الزيت مع سقايتها وهي تطهى.
steps.n3: تُقدم البيضات بجانب الجبنة المقلية مع الملح والفلفل.

en.title: Eggs with Fried White Cheese (Beid Ma'li ma' Jibneh Beida)
en.intro: Recipe 64, page 29 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Fry the cheese one slice at a time, turning it to colour both sides, and keep it warm at the side of the serving dish.
steps.n2: Fry the eggs in the same oil, basting them as they cook.
steps.n3: Serve the eggs next to the fried cheese, sprinkled with salt and pepper.

legacySteps: Fry the cheese one slice at a time, turning it to colour both sides, and keep it warm at the side of the serving dish.
Fry the eggs in the same oil, basting them as they cook.
Serve the eggs next to the fried cheese, sprinkled with salt and pepper.
